_readme: FIAT OUTSTANDING ART, THE TEST (19 Oct, Matt): the Map's Outskirts - its ground, clipped to the zone's shape, and its three sites under their pins. In the game before the rest.

Run: godot --headless --script res://tools/pixellab_batch_v2.gd ++ --manifest res://tools/pixellab_outstanding_test_manifest.json   (++ --dry-run to list; ++ --only <name> ++ --force to reroll). Regenerate with python3 tools/make_outstanding_manifest.py.

jobs.description: Pixel art, seen straight down from directly above like an aerial photograph turned into a painted map: farmland on the edge of a northern English town: small fields with hedgerows and dry-stone walls, a lane between them, a copse, allotment plots with sheds, a farmyard's roofs, ploughed earth and overgrown grass. The whole frame filled edge to edge with ground, no horizon, no sky, no border, no frame, no vignette. Muted blue-grey and slate palette with muted greens and browns, dusk light, a few warm orange lights; quiet and empty, no people, no vehicles moving, no text, no labels, no readable signs or numbers. Even detail all over: the picture is cut to an irregular shape and drawn under markers, so nothing in it should be the only thing worth looking at.
jobs._where: the Map: The Outskirts's ground, clipped to its shape (box (0, 520, 380, 844) in the 1000 x 844 drawing, drawn x2)

jobs.description: Pixel art, a small map vignette seen from above at a steep angle, as on a hand-painted town map: a patchwork of allotment plots with sheds, a greenhouse and water butts, a path down the middle. One place only, centred, about two thirds of the frame, on a transparent background, no ground beyond its own edge, no border. Muted blue-grey palette with muted greens and browns, dusk light, one or two warm orange lights; no people, no text, no readable signs or numbers. It must read at this size: a single strong shape.
jobs._where: the Map: The Allotments under its pin
